item.description:
Domain warnings stay visible when a page cannot be read

  • Recognizes links that spell a known company's full domain inside a different domain, including short names such as X.
  • Matches a visible company sender name to an imitating link even when a message only asks you to view a report.
  • Keeps strong local warnings prominent when the online check cannot calculate a score.
  • Shows the server's URL findings and inspection coverage without a separate numeric URL rating.

Saved monitoring, cloud, privacy and notification preferences stay in place. Domain observations do not authenticate a sender. Existing check history is unchanged.
